description: A woman in a white lace-collared blouse, dark skirt and straw hat with a flower trim stands in the foreground, holding a folded paper, looking off to the right. Behind her a line of women in long skirts and hats stands under eucalyptus branches beside a weatherboard wooden building with an open doorway, where another woman in a hat holds something near the door. Harsh sunlight and deep shadow, painterly brushwork, no visible letters or frame.
